data: All retained observations in the two supplied development crops; no new donor
primary_object: One common patch-atlas model per crop and one unique count interval per cell/gene/budget
reference: Exact raster pixel-edge partition; no interpolated alternative source segmentation
eligibility: Positive source cells must be connected and avoid crop borders; background pieces may participate as label0. Every proposed patch must lie inside the supplied crop.
candidate_arcs: All shared raster interfaces between eligible labels, traced into paths, then maximal coordinate-monotone runs; maximum 128 unit edges per run; trim one edge at each end; retain at least four remaining edges
coordinate_system: t=sx*x+sy*y, u=sx*x-sy*y in pixel coordinates, then subtract exact source graph f0(t); physical Jacobian p^2/2
selection: Longest remaining reference arc first, then deterministic label/coordinate order; widest feasible width. No RNA count, gene, effect or solver outcome is used for candidate ranking.
conditions: Each side of ribbon wholly inside its reference cell, pairwise interior-disjoint patches, fixed endpoint and rail traces; every intersecting nuclear pixel retained through conservative exact structural bounds in the shear chart; all rejected candidates recorded.
interpretation: Conditional extrema of observed molecule counts under this global atlas. Marker co-detection is not proof of cell type, signaling, error or doublets.
exterior: All unselected boundaries, crop-border cells, nuclei and junction neighborhoods fixed; reports mutable shared-boundary coverage
amendment_before_count_queries: Replace nucleus-free eligibility by universally fixed nuclear-owner inequalities. Initial nucleus-free extraction is archived; no interval or marker outcome informed this amendment. Include cell-background interfaces so count changes may include originally unassigned observations, rather than silently freeze most exposed perimeters.
boundary_scope: Every eligible complete-cell interface, including shared cell-cell interfaces and cell-background interfaces; background remains reference label 0 and is not a biological cell.
